items.exampleEn: The old house is fully repaired now.
items.exampleZh: 這間老房子現在已經完全修好了。

items.exampleEn: Bring an extra jacket. It might get cold.
items.exampleZh: 多帶一件外套，天氣可能會變冷。

items.exampleEn: Ten divided by two is five.
An enormous wave hit the boat.
There are plenty of seats at the back.
Can you do this addition in your head?
The ticket is ten dollars, plus two dollars for the bag.
items.exampleZh: 票價十元，袋子另加兩元。

items.audioEn: We have plenty of time, so let's walk to the station.
items.audioZh: 我們時間很充裕，走路去車站吧。

items.sentenceEn: Divide the class into three groups.

items.stemEn: Look at that ____ ship! It's as big as a building.
items.stemZh: 你看那艘巨大的船！跟一棟大樓一樣大。

items.stemEn: Can I have ____ sauce on my pizza?
items.stemZh: 我的披薩可以多加一點醬嗎？

items.passageEn: Last Saturday was my sister's birthday. Twenty kids, plus their parents, came to the party. Mom made an enormous cake, and we had to divide it into thirty pieces. In addition to the cake, we had plenty of ice cream for dessert. Some kids asked for extra chocolate. The house was extremely noisy, but everyone had lots of fun. By the end, every plate was empty!
items.passageZh: 上週六是我妹妹的生日。二十個小朋友，加上他們的爸媽，都來參加派對。媽媽做了一個超大的蛋糕，我們得把它分成三十塊。除了蛋糕，我們還有很多冰淇淋當甜點。有些小朋友還要多加巧克力。家裡非常吵，但大家都玩得很開心。到最後，每個盤子都空了！

questions.questionZh: 除了蛋糕，甜點還有什麼？

referenceEn: I fully understand what you mean.
rubricZh: fully 常放在動詞前（例如 fully understand）

referenceEn: My little brother can't do addition yet.
My younger brother can't do addition yet.
rubricZh: 用 addition 表示「加法」（例如 do addition）
「還不會」可寫，例如 can't…yet、doesn't know how to…yet 等
「弟弟」可寫，例如 little brother、younger brother 等
